intro: Interventional Radiology Consultant and Chief Medical Officer at Aman Hospital, specialising in minimally invasive image-guided treatment.
biography: Dr. Ali A. Haydar, MD, MRCP, FRCR, EMBA, is widely recognized as one of the most accomplished interventional radiologists in the Middle East. Serving as Chief Medical Officer and Chair of Diagnostic & Interventional Radiology Services at Aman Hospital, he combines more than 15 years of advanced clinical experience with a patient-centred approach. Fluent in Arabic, English, and French, Dr. Haydar specialises in minimally invasive, image-guided procedures for vascular, oncologic, and emergency conditions.
